skill.name: bio-variant-calling-structural-variant-calling
skill.description: Call structural variants (SVs) from short-read sequencing using Manta, Delly, and LUMPY. Detects deletions, insertions, inversions, duplications, and translocations that are too large for standard SNV callers.
skill.body:
# Structural Variant Calling (Short Reads)

## Manta (Recommended)

```bash
# Configure Manta run (creates runWorkflow.py)
configManta.py \
    --bam sample.bam \
    --referenceFasta reference.fa \
    --runDir manta_run

# Execute
manta_run/runWorkflow.py -j 8

# Output: manta_run/results/variants/
# - diploidSV.vcf.gz (germline SVs)
# - candidateSV.vcf.gz (all candidates)
# - candidateSmallIndels.vcf.gz (small indels)
```

## Manta Tumor-Normal Mode

```bash
# Somatic SV calling
configManta.py \
    --tumorBam tumor.bam \
    --normalBam normal.bam \
    --referenceFasta reference.fa \
    --runDir manta_somatic

manta_somatic/runWorkflow.py -j 8

# Output includes:
# - somaticSV.vcf.gz (somatic SVs)
# - diploidSV.vcf.gz (germline SVs)
```

## Manta Options

```bash
# WES mode (for exome data)
configManta.py \
    --bam sample.bam \
    --referenceFasta reference.fa \
    --exome \                          # Use exome settings
    --callRegions regions.bed.gz \     # Restrict to regions
    --runDir manta_exome

# RNA-seq mode
configManta.py \
    --bam rnaseq.bam \
    --referenceFasta reference.fa \
    --rna \                            # RNA-seq mode
    --runDir manta_rna
```

## Delly

```bash
# Call SVs
delly call \
    -g reference.fa \
    -o sv_calls.bcf \
    sample.bam

# Convert to VCF
bcftools view sv_calls.bcf > sv_calls.vcf

# Multiple samples (joint calling)
delly call \
    -g reference.fa \
    -o joint_svs.bcf \
    sample1.bam sample2.bam sample3.bam
```

## Delly Somatic Mode

```bash
# Call with tumor-normal
delly call \
    -g reference.fa \
    -o svs.bcf \
    tumor.bam normal.bam

# Create sample file
echo -e "tumor\ttumor\nnormal\tcontrol" > samples.tsv

# Filter for somatic
delly filter \
    -f somatic \
    -o somatic_svs.bcf \
    -s samples.tsv \
    svs.bcf
```

## Delly SV Types

```bash
# Call specific SV type
delly call -t DEL -g ref.fa -o deletions.bcf sample.bam
delly call -t DUP -g ref.fa -o duplications.bcf sample.bam
delly call -t INV -g ref.fa -o inversions.bcf sample.bam
delly call -t BND -g ref.fa -o translocations.bcf sample.bam
delly call -t INS -g ref.fa -o insertions.bcf sample.bam
```

## LUMPY

```bash
# Extract split reads and discordant pairs
samtools view -b -F 1294 sample.bam > discordant.bam
samtools view -h sample.bam | \
    /path/to/lumpy-sv/scripts/extractSplitReads_BwaMem -i stdin | \
    samtools view -Sb - > splitters.bam

# Run LUMPY
lumpyexpress \
    -B sample.bam \
    -S splitters.bam \
    -D discordant.bam \
    -o lumpy_svs.vcf
```

## Smoove (LUMPY Wrapper)

```bash
# Simplified LUMPY workflow
smoove call \
    --name sample \
    --fasta reference.fa \
    --outdir smoove_output \
    -p 8 \
    sample.bam

# Output: smoove_output/sample-smoove.genotyped.vcf.gz
```

## Merge Multiple Callers

```bash
# Use SURVIVOR to merge callsets
# Create file listing VCFs
ls manta_svs.vcf delly_svs.vcf lumpy_svs.vcf > vcf_list.txt

# Merge with parameters
SURVIVOR merge vcf_list.txt 1000 2 1 1 0 50 merged_svs.vcf

# Parameters: max_dist min_callers type_agree strand_agree estimate_dist min_size
```

## Filter SV Calls

```bash
# Filter by quality
bcftools view -i 'QUAL >= 20' svs.vcf > svs.filtered.vcf

# Filter by size
bcftools view -i 'ABS(SVLEN) >= 50' svs.vcf > svs.min50.vcf

# Filter by SV type
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="DEL"' svs.vcf > deletions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="INS"' svs.vcf > insertions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="INV"' svs.vcf > inversions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="DUP"' svs.vcf > duplications.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="BND"' svs.vcf > translocations.vcf

# Keep only PASS
bcftools view -f PASS svs.vcf > svs.pass.vcf
```

## Annotate SVs

```bash
# AnnotSV annotation
AnnotSV \
    -SVinputFile svs.vcf \
    -genomeBuild GRCh38 \
    -outputFile annotated_svs

# Output includes: genes, DGV, gnomAD-SV, ClinVar
```

## SV Types

| Type | Code | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Deletion | DEL | Sequence removed |
| Insertion | INS | Sequence inserted |
| Inversion | INV | Sequence reversed |
| Duplication | DUP | Sequence duplicated |
| Translocation | BND | Breakend (inter-chromosomal) |

## Comparison: Manta vs Delly vs LUMPY

| Feature | Manta | Delly | LUMPY |
|---------|-------|-------|-------|
| Speed | Fast | Medium | Medium |
| Sensitivity | High | High | High |
| Small SVs | Good | Moderate | Good |
| Large SVs | Good | Good | Good |
| RNA-seq | Yes | No | No |
| Somatic | Yes | Yes | Limited |

## Coverage Guidelines

| Coverage | Detection Ability |
|----------|-------------------|
| 10x | Large SVs (>1kb) |
| 30x | Most SVs |
| 50x+ | Small SVs, better breakpoints |

## Related Skills

- long-read-sequencing/structural-variants - Long-read SV calling
- copy-number/cnvkit-analysis - Copy number variants
- variant-calling/vcf-filtering - Filter VCF files
- alignment-files/alignment-filtering - Prepare BAM files

generated_query: I have whole-genome sequencing data from a cancer patient's tumor and matched normal sample (tumor.bam and normal.bam, aligned to hg38.fa). I need to detect structural variants—deletions, duplications, inversions, and translocations—larger than 100 bp. Could you set up two independent callers: Manta in somatic mode (tumor-normal) and Delly for tumor-normal somatic calling, then merge the resulting VCFs with SURVIVOR (minimum 1 kb distance, require at least 2 callers, and agreement on SV type). After merging, filter for somatic PASS calls with QUAL ≥ 30 and SVLEN ≥ 100. Finally, annotate the merged SV calls with AnnotSV using GRCh38. I need the final filtered annotated VCF and a summary of the number of each SV type detected.

variant_skill_bodies.counterfactual_skill_body:
# Structural Variant Calling for Cancer Genomics

## Manta Somatic Mode

```bash
# Configure Manta for tumor-normal somatic calling
configManta.py \
    --tumorBam tumor.bam \
    --normalBam normal.bam \
    --referenceFasta hg38.fa \
    --runDir manta_somatic

# Run the workflow
manta_somatic/runWorkflow.py -j 8

# Output: manta_somatic/results/variants/somaticSV.vcf.gz
```

## Delly Somatic Calling

```bash
# Generate BCF with both samples
delly call \
    -g hg38.fa \
    -o delly_raw.bcf \
    tumor.bam normal.bam

# Prepare sample file
echo -e "tumor\ttumor\nnormal\tcontrol" > samples.tsv

# Filter for somatic events
delly filter \
    -f somatic \
    -o delly_somatic.bcf \
    -s samples.tsv \
    delly_raw.bcf

# Convert to VCF
bcftools view delly_somatic.bcf > delly_somatic.vcf
```

## Merge with SURVIVOR

```bash
# List caller VCFs
echo "manta_somatic/results/variants/somaticSV.vcf.gz" > vcf_list.txt
echo "delly_somatic.vcf" >> vcf_list.txt

# Merge parameters: max distance 500 bp, min 1 caller, no type agreement, strand agree, estimate distance, min size 50
SURVIVOR merge vcf_list.txt 500 1 0 1 0 50 merged_raw.vcf
```

## Filter Merged Calls

```bash
# Keep PASS calls with QUAL >= 20 and SVLEN >= 50
bcftools view -f PASS merged_raw.vcf | \
    bcftools view -i 'QUAL >= 20 && SVLEN >= 50' -o filtered_merged.vcf

# Separate by SV type
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="DEL"' filtered_merged.vcf > deletions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="DUP"' filtered_merged.vcf > duplications.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="INV"' filtered_merged.vcf > inversions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="BND"' filtered_merged.vcf > translocations.vcf
```

## Annotate with AnnotSV (hg38)

```bash
AnnotSV \
    -SVinputFile filtered_merged.vcf \
    -genomeBuild GRCh38 \
    -outputFile annotated_svs
```

## Summarize SV Types

```bash
echo "Deletions: $(grep -c 'SVTYPE=DEL' filtered_merged.vcf)"
echo "Duplications: $(grep -c 'SVTYPE=DUP' filtered_merged.vcf)"
echo "Inversions: $(grep -c 'SVTYPE=INV' filtered_merged.vcf)"
echo "Translocations: $(grep -c 'SVTYPE=BND' filtered_merged.vcf)"
```

## Notes

- The SURVIVOR merge uses relaxed parameters; adjust `max_dist` and `min_callers` for stricter merging.
- For more sensitive SV detection, consider adding LUMPY or other callers.
- AnnotSV output includes gene annotations, population frequencies, and clinical relevance.
- All commands assume your environment has the necessary tools installed (Manta, Delly, SURVIVOR, bcftools, AnnotSV).

```bash
    --bam rnaseq.bam \
    --referenceFasta reference.fa \
    --rna \                            # RNA-seq mode
    --runDir manta_rna
```

## Delly

```bash
# Call SVs
delly call \
    -g reference.fa \
    -o sv_calls.bcf \
    sample.bam

# Convert to VCF
bcftools view sv_calls.bcf > sv_calls.vcf

# Multiple samples (joint calling)
delly call \
    -g reference.fa \
    -o joint_svs.bcf \
    sample1.bam sample2.bam sample3.bam
```

## Delly Somatic Mode

```bash
# Call with tumor-normal
delly call \
    -g reference.fa \
    -o svs.bcf \
    tumor.bam normal.bam

# Create sample file
echo -e "tumor\ttumor\nnormal\tcontrol" > samples.tsv

# Filter for somatic
delly filter \
    -f somatic \
    -o somatic_svs.bcf \
    -s samples.tsv \
    svs.bcf
```

## LUMPY

```bash
# Extract split reads and discordant pairs
samtools view -b -F 1294 sample.bam > discordant.bam
samtools view -h sample.bam | \
    /path/to/lumpy-sv/scripts/extractSplitReads_BwaMem -i stdin | \
    samtools view -Sb - > splitters.bam

# Run LUMPY
lumpyexpress \
    -B sample.bam \
    -S splitters.bam \
    -D discordant.bam \
    -o lumpy_svs.vcf
```

## Merge Multiple Callers

```bash
# Use SURVIVOR to merge callsets
# Create file listing VCFs
ls manta_svs.vcf delly_svs.vcf lumpy_svs.vcf > vcf_list.txt

# Merge with parameters
bcftools merge --merge all -o merged_svs.vcf manta_svs.vcf delly_svs.vcf lumpy_svs.vcf

# Parameters: max_dist min_callers type_agree strand_agree estimate_dist min_size
```

## Filter SV Calls

```bash
# Filter by quality
bcftools view -i 'QUAL >= 20' svs.vcf > svs.filtered.vcf

# Filter by size
bcftools view -i 'ABS(SVLEN) >= 50' svs.vcf > svs.min50.vcf

# Filter by SV type
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="DEL"' svs.vcf > deletions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="INS"' svs.vcf > insertions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="INV"' svs.vcf > inversions.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="DUP"' svs.vcf > duplications.vcf
bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="BND"' svs.vcf > translocations.vcf

# Keep only PASS
bcftools view -f PASS svs.vcf > svs.pass.vcf
```

## SV Types

| Type | Code | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Deletion | DEL | Sequence removed |
| Insertion | INS | Sequence inserted |
| Inversion | INV | Sequence reversed |
| Duplication | DUP | Sequence duplicated |
| Translocation | BND | Breakend (inter-chromosomal) |

## Comparison: Manta vs Delly vs LUMPY

| Feature | Manta | Delly | LUMPY |
|---------|-------|-------|-------|
| Speed | Fast | Medium | Medium |
| Sensitivity | High | High | High |
| Small SVs | Good | Moderate | Good |
| Large SVs | Good | Good | Good |
| RNA-seq | Yes | No | No |
| Somatic | Yes | Yes | Limited |

## Coverage Guidelines

| Coverage | Detection Ability |
|----------|-------------------|
| 10x | Large SVs (>1kb) |
| 30x | Most SVs |
| 50x+ | Small SVs, better breakpoints |
